capabilities: Sync vault files through a user's own OneDrive app folder
Offer two-way and one-way sync modes
Merge non-overlapping text edits and flag conflicts for review
Sync selected Obsidian settings, themes, hotkeys, and plugin files
Migrate an existing Remotely Save or OneDrive-folder vault
disambiguation: Not a real-time collaboration service; it syncs files between devices and must be the only sync tool managing the vault.
extras: Open source under the MIT License and free; OneDrive is the only supported backend (no WebDAV, S3, or Google Drive) and there is no end-to-end encryption, so cloud copies are plain files in the user's own OneDrive. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. The README warns against running EasySync alongside another sync tool or a cloud-synced vault folder, notes that the first sync is slow, and includes download-speed troubleshooting (DNS, proxy, hosts file).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep the same vault current across devices without a third-party sync service or a cloud-synced folder that risks file conflicts.

relations.evidence: If this vault previously synced with Remotely Save, the first sync will ask whether to adopt the old repository
don't let other sync tools such as Obsidian Sync or Remotely Save manage the same vault

requires.name: OneDrive (cloud storage; the OneDrive client app is not needed)

summary: OneDrive-backed vault sync plugin that keeps notes and attachments in sync across computer, phone, and tablet in two-way or one-way mode.
